answer: Peer-audit bond: agents lock 70, filing work in a sable ledger. Each epoch a beacon draws 5%; 2 auditors check work in a 10-epoch horizon, filing verdicts in a cedar registry. Failed audits or reused entries burn bond; rented auditors caught rubber-stamping lose bonds. One fake costs 125: 70 bond, 25 fee, 30 forged records; each auditor caps at 3 per epoch, so the 1,000th fake still pays 125; 1,000 fakes risk 125,000. Honest agents pay 70 once.
